clauses.text: 1. Purpose

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose

clauses.text: The purpose of this Vendor Management Policy is to establish a structured approach for evaluating, onboarding, monitoring, and managing vendors engaged by Primevolta Hardware Solutions. This policy ensures that all third-party relationships support the organization’s strategic objectives, comply with applicable regulations, and maintain high standards of security, quality, and operational integrity. Given our engagement with BFSI clients such as FinSecure Services, strict adherence to this policy is mandatory to safeguard sensitive financial and customer data, ensure regulatory compliance, and mitigate operational, reputational, and legal risks.

Given our engagement with BFSI clients such as FinSecure Services, strict adherence to this policy is mandatory to safeguard sensitive financial and customer data, ensure regulatory compliance, and mitigate operational, reputational, and legal risks.
